run_visualizer_cli: run the Visualizer CLI to generate an MP4 video of model predictions vs ground truth rollout
create_visualizer_instance: create a Visualizer instance with a lookahead horizon, results directory, and optional agent directory
run_vis_rollout: run the vis_rollout generator to yield observation, reward, and action data for each environment step
get_obs_rewards_and_actions: get real and model-predicted observations, rewards, and actions from a given state with optional MPC
create_axes_and_plot: create matplotlib axes and plot lines comparing real trajectory data against model predictions with uncertainty bounds
